title: skins.equip (server → platform, ephemeral)
description: Proposed by Ready Up (the in-game inventory). A connected player equipped one of their items in game, or took it off: `team` 0 = both sides, 2 = T, 3 = CT (a weapon only one side buys is always both); `unequip` true empties that item's slot for `team`. The platform applies it as its own equip does (the same checks: the item must be the player's) and answers with skins.inventory and, when the loadout changed, skins.loadout.
